design_origin: Repair informed by previously opened typed-retention confirmation; all previous runs remain development evidence
frozen_models: All 18 original final-step typed-retention checkpoints; no retraining, selection, or changed tensor
raw_generator_namespace: data.STREAMS[confirm] + seed = 420000000 + seed; generator uses its train-seed interface unchanged
statistics: For each task and core, average paired score improvement over the three fixed checkpoints within each episode, then bootstrap independent episodes. One-sided Bonferroni lower bounds at 0.05/12. Queries and the three fixed fits are not independent replicates. Inference is conditional on these fixed checkpoints and this generator, not a training-seed population.
abstention_gate: Per fixed model: one-sided exact binomial lower bound for no error among accepted predictions in an episode, using independent episodes with at least one accepted query and Bonferroni alpha 0.05/18, must exceed 0.99; coverage reported without a positive gate
validity_gates: All model checkpoints and all frozen source hashes match before and after execution
Closed-form causal posterior and independent latent enumeration agree within 1e-14 on all 48 registered prefixes
No illegal zero evidence, no unavailable-label input, and every output distribution normalized within 1e-12
All known-posterior query distributions and every no-erasure model output remain byte-identical after repair
read_gate: All 1536 actual delayed missing-WRITE acquisitions condition on raw returned tokens and recover all four true values. READ selected from posterior value and current price before scoring; both actual successors retained. No criterion based on observed test reward selects a policy.
failure_rule: Preserve every failed model, history, worker and cost. Any missing or invalid required result makes acceptance false. No epsilon floor, subset deletion, rerandomization, refit, threshold change or pooling with development outcomes.
cost_rule: Measure whole fresh process including imports, reference enumeration, all 18 model evaluations, repair, serialization and actual READ continuations. Preserve nested timers without adding them twice. Frozen models inherit old training cost; this experiment does not establish a complete deployment cost advantage.
scope: Prospective known-generator calibration repair shared by ordinary and analytical cores; no D-B benefit, learned missingness, new semantic task family, real multimodal admission, GPU or joule claim
